tasks.taskSummary: Prepared the Java API, web frontend, and C++ worker for containerized AWS runtime configuration. Java now requires external datasource/JWT/encryption/worker-token settings, uses Flyway with schema validation, disables SQL logging, defaults secure cookies on, and starts from a non-root JRE image. The C++ worker requires API_BASE_URL and APP_WORKER_SERVICE_TOKEN and uses a non-root multi-stage image; the web Nginx upstream is runtime-configurable. Compose uses explicit API/upstream configuration and rejects missing database credentials rather than supplying a weak default. All three local Docker image builds passed; Spring package build passed; 5/5 isolated Java unit tests passed; Compose and rendered Nginx configuration validated. Database-backed integration/context testing was not run. No AWS calls, resource operations, deployment, staging, or commit occurred. ECS desired count remains a task-002 infrastructure setting and should be one for the worker.
risks: Database-backed Spring context and integration behavior were not validated because this task did not start or provision a database.
followUps: Task 002 must set the ECS worker desired count to one unless duplicate-trade coordination is designed.
Run the database-backed integration and context checks in task 004 using an isolated PostgreSQL instance and mocks.

tasks.taskSummary: Completed dependency CVE remediation: the pre-fix OSV scan found 31 affected dependency/advisory matches covering 22 distinct advisories across Log4j, Tomcat, Spring MVC, PostgreSQL, and Jackson; upgraded the Spring Boot parent from 4.1.0 to 4.1.2, then rescanned 117 resolved Maven coordinates with zero OSV matches. A temporary-lock npm audit covered 76 resolved web dependencies and found zero advisories. Added .dockerignore files to all three image build contexts to exclude .env* files; the root .env matches the .gitignore rule and was inspected without printing values. Maven test-compile passed and 5/5 isolated Java unit tests passed. No AWS calls, resource operations, deployment, staging, or commit occurred. Task remains blocked for production-boundary verification: no Terraform/AWS infrastructure exists to verify HTTPS-only public ingress, private database access, or worker ingress, and task 002's cost and HTTPS/TLS decisions remain unresolved. Compose currently publishes local API, web, and database ports; do not treat it as production ingress. Git history/secret tracking and production log contents were not independently audited.
risks: Production public-ingress, private-database, and worker network boundaries cannot be verified without approved infrastructure; task 002 is blocked.
Git history/secret tracking and production log contents were not independently audited; the local .env matches the root ignore rule and was not disclosed.
The web package declares dependencies as latest and has no lockfile, so npm audit assessed current registry resolution only.
followUps: After task 002 is unblocked, verify HTTPS-only public ingress, private database access, and no inbound worker access before task 006.
Add and review a web package lockfile to make future dependency installation and CVE scans reproducible.
